sentences.zh: 至於五等封爵，除刑若盡，永即甄削，便同之除名，於例實爽。

translations.literal: As for the five grades of enfeoffment, once punishment is fully served they are permanently struck off—equivalent to removal from the register—which in fact departs from precedent.
translations.idiomatic: As for the five grades of enfeoffment, once punishment is fully served the title is permanently revoked—equal to removal from the register—which in fact departs from precedent.

sentences.zh: 愚謂自王公以下，有封邑，罪除名，三年之後，宜各降本爵一等，王及郡公降為縣公，公為侯，侯為伯，伯為子，子為男，至于縣男，則降為鄉男。

translations.literal: This humble opinion holds that from princes and dukes downward, those with fiefs who are stripped of name—after three years each should be reduced one grade from his original rank: kings and commandery dukes to county dukes, dukes to marquises, marquises to earls, earls to viscounts, viscounts to barons, and county barons to township barons.
translations.idiomatic: We hold that from princes and dukes downward, those with fiefs who suffer removal from the register—after three years each should be reduced one grade from his original title: kings and commandery dukes to county dukes, dukes to marquises, marquises to earls, earls to viscounts, viscounts to barons, and county barons to township barons.

sentences.zh: 五等爵者，亦依此而降，至於散男。

translations.literal: Those of the five grades of nobility likewise shall be reduced according to this, down to unsalaried barons.
translations.idiomatic: Holders of the five grades of nobility should likewise be reduced step by step down to unsalaried barons.

sentences.zh: 其鄉男無可降授者，三年之後，聽依其本品之資出身。

translations.literal: Where township barons have no rank left to which they may be reduced, after three years they may enter service according to the qualifications of their original rank.
translations.idiomatic: Where township barons have no further rank to which they may be reduced, after three years they may enter service according to the qualifications of their original rank.

sentences.zh: 」詔從之。

translations.literal: " The edict approved this.
translations.idiomatic: The edict approved this.

sentences.zh: 其年秋，符璽郎中高□賢、弟員外散騎侍郎仲賢、叔司徒府主簿六珍等，坐弟季賢同元愉逆，除名為民，會赦之後，被旨勿論。

translations.literal: That autumn, Seal and Credence Officer Gao □ Xian, his younger brother Extraordinary Gentleman Attendant at the Vacant Horse Zhong Xian, and his uncle Chief Clerk of the Minister of Education's Office Liu Zhen and others, because their younger brother Ji Xian joined Yuan Yu's rebellion, were stripped of name and made commoners; after the general amnesty they received an edict that they not be prosecuted.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, Seal and Credence Officer Gao □ Xian, his younger brother Extraordinary Attendant at the Vacant Horse Zhong Xian, and his uncle Chief Clerk of the Secretariat of the Minister of Education Liu Zhen and others, because their younger brother Ji Xian joined Yuan Yu's rebellion, were stripped of official standing and reduced to commoners; after a general amnesty they received an edict that they not be prosecuted.

sentences.zh: 尚書邢巒奏：「案季賢既受逆官，為其傳檄，規扇幽瀛，遘茲禍亂，據律準犯，罪當孥戮，兄叔坐法，法有明典。

translations.literal: Master of Writing Xing Luan memorialized: "The case shows Ji Xian already accepted a rebellious appointment, drafted proclamations for him, plotted to incite You and Ying, and brought on this calamity and turmoil; measured against the law and the offense, his crime warrants execution of the entire family; his elder brothers and uncles are punished by law—the code has clear precedents.
translations.idiomatic: Master of Writing Xing Luan memorialized: "Ji Xian had already accepted office under the rebel, drafted proclamations for him, plotted to stir up You and Ying, and brought on this calamity; by law his crime warrants execution of the entire family, and his elder brothers and uncles are liable under clear statutory provisions.

sentences.zh: 賴蒙大宥，身命獲全，除名還民，於其為幸。

translations.literal: Relying on the great pardon, their lives were preserved; stripped of name and returned to the people—for them this was fortune.
translations.idiomatic: Thanks to the great pardon their lives were spared and they were stripped of name and returned to common status—for them this was already good fortune.

sentences.zh: 然反逆坐重，故支屬相及。

translations.literal: Yet rebellion is a heavy offense, therefore collateral kin are implicated.
translations.idiomatic: Yet rebellion is a grave offense, and therefore collateral kin are implicated.

sentences.zh: 體既相及，事同一科，豈有赦前皆從流斬之罪，赦後獨除反者之身。

translations.literal: Since the liability extends to the body of kin, the offense is of one category—how can there be, before the amnesty, offenses all subject to exile or execution, yet after the amnesty only the rebels themselves exempted?
translations.idiomatic: Since kin are implicated alike, the offense is of one category—how can offenses that before the amnesty all carried exile or execution be lifted after the amnesty for the rebels alone?

sentences.zh: 又緣坐之罪，不得以職除流。

translations.literal: Moreover, offenses by association may not have exile removed by rank.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, for offenses by association, exile may not be remitted through rank.

sentences.zh: 且貨賕小愆，寇盜微戾，贓狀露驗者，會赦猶除其名。

translations.literal: Moreover, for petty bribery or minor banditry and theft, when evidence of guilt is exposed and verified, even at general amnesty their names are still removed.
translations.idiomatic: Even for petty bribery or minor theft, when evidence of guilt is verified, names are still removed even at general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 何有罪極裂冠，釁均毀冕，父子齊刑，兄弟共罰，赦前同斬從流，赦後有復官之理。

translations.literal: How can there be, for crimes extreme as tearing the cap and equal in offense to destroying the crown, fathers and sons punished together and brothers punished jointly—before the amnesty alike subject to execution or exile, yet after the amnesty grounds for restoration to office?
translations.idiomatic: How then can crimes as grave as treason—tearing the cap, defiling the crown—where fathers and sons suffer alike and brothers share punishment, be subject before the amnesty to execution or exile, yet after the amnesty provide grounds for restoration to office?

sentences.zh: 依律則罪合孥戮，準赦則例皆除名。

translations.literal: By law the crime warrants execution of the entire family; by amnesty precedent all are stripped of name.
translations.idiomatic: By law the crime warrants execution of the entire family; by amnesty precedent all should be stripped of name.

sentences.zh: 古人議無將之罪者，毀其室，洿其宮，絕其蹤，滅其類。

translations.literal: When ancients discussed the crime of failure to restrain kin, they destroyed the house, defiled the palace, cut off the lineage, and extinguished the kindred.
translations.idiomatic: When the ancients discussed the crime of failing to restrain rebellious kin, they destroyed the house, defiled the dwelling, cut off the lineage, and extinguished the clan.

sentences.zh: 其宅猶棄，而況人乎？

translations.literal: Even the dwelling was abandoned—how much more so the person?
translations.idiomatic: Even the dwelling was abandoned—how much more so the person?

sentences.zh: 請依律處，除名為民。

translations.literal: We request punishment according to law—stripped of name and made commoners.
translations.idiomatic: We request that they be punished according to law and stripped of name, reduced to commoners.

sentences.zh: 」詔曰：「死者既在赦前，又員外非在正侍之限，便可悉聽復仕。」

translations.literal: " The edict said: "The deceased was already before the amnesty, and the extraordinary attendant was not within the limit of regular attendance—let them all be permitted to return to office."
translations.idiomatic: The edict said: "The deceased fell before the amnesty, and the extraordinary attendant was not within the regular attendance roster—let them all be permitted to return to office."

sentences.zh: 三年，尚書李平奏：「冀州阜城民費羊皮母亡，家貧無以葬，賣七歲子與同城人張回為婢。

translations.literal: In the third year, Master of Writing Li Ping memorialized: "Fei Yangpi, a commoner of Fucheng in Ji Province, his mother died; the family was poor and had no means for burial, so he sold his seven-year-old daughter to Zhang Hui, a fellow townsman, as a maidservant.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, Master of Writing Li Ping memorialized: "Fei Yangpi of Fucheng in Ji Province, his mother having died and the family too poor to bury her, sold his seven-year-old daughter to a fellow townsman named Zhang Hui as a maidservant.

sentences.zh: 回轉賣於鄃縣民梁定之，而不言良狀。

translations.literal: Hui then resold her to Liang Dingzhi, a commoner of Yu County, without stating her freeborn status.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Hui then resold her to Liang Dingzhi of Yu County without disclosing that she was freeborn.

sentences.zh: 案盜律『掠人、掠賣人、和賣人為奴婢者，死』。

translations.literal: According to the Theft Statute: 'Those who seize persons, seize and sell persons, or jointly sell persons as slaves or maidservants—death.'
translations.idiomatic: According to the Theft Statute: "Those who abduct persons, abduct and sell persons, or jointly sell persons into servitude—death."

sentences.zh: 回故買羊皮女，謀以轉賣。

translations.literal: Hui deliberately bought Fei Yangpi's daughter, intending to resell her.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Hui deliberately bought Fei Yangpi's daughter with intent to resell her.

sentences.zh: 依律處絞刑。

translations.literal: According to law, sentence to strangulation.
translations.idiomatic: By law he should be sentenced to strangulation.

sentences.zh: 」詔曰：「律稱和賣人者，謂兩人詐取他財。

translations.literal: " The edict said: "Where the law speaks of jointly selling persons, it means two people who deceitfully obtain another's property.
translations.idiomatic: The edict said: "Where the law speaks of jointly selling persons, it means two people who by fraud obtain another's property.

sentences.zh: 今羊皮賣女，告回稱良，張回利賤，知良公買。

translations.literal: Now Yangpi sold his daughter, telling Hui she was freeborn; Zhang Hui profited from a cheap price, knowing she was freeborn and buying openly.
translations.idiomatic: Here Fei Yangpi sold his daughter, telling Zhang Hui she was freeborn; Zhang Hui profited from the low price, knowing she was freeborn and buying openly.

sentences.zh: 誠於律俱乖，而兩各非詐。

translations.literal: Truly both departed from the law, yet neither side acted by fraud.
translations.idiomatic: Truly both departed from the law, yet neither acted by fraud.

sentences.zh: 此女雖父賣為婢，體本是良。

translations.literal: Though this girl was sold by her father as a maidservant, in substance she was originally freeborn.
translations.idiomatic: Though her father sold her as a maidservant, she was by status freeborn.

sentences.zh: 回轉賣之日，應有遲疑，而〔決從真賣。

translations.literal: On the day Hui resold her, he ought to have hesitated, yet [—] he resolved to sell her in truth.
translations.idiomatic: On the day Zhang Hui resold her, he ought to have hesitated, yet [text missing—] he proceeded to sell her outright.

sentences.zh: [3]於情不可。

translations.literal: [3] By sentiment this is not acceptable.
translations.idiomatic: [3] By any reasonable standard this is unacceptable.

sentences.zh: 更推例以為永式。

translations.literal: Further derive a precedent and establish it as a permanent rule.
translations.idiomatic: Further derive a precedent and establish it as permanent law.

sentences.zh: 〔廷尉少卿楊鈞議曰：[4]「謹詳盜律『掠人、掠賣人為奴婢者，皆死』，別條『賣子孫者，一歲刑』。

translations.literal: [ Vice Minister of the Court of Justice Yang Jun opined: [4] "I have carefully examined the Theft Statute: 'Those who seize persons or seize and sell persons as slaves or maidservants—all death'; a separate article: 'Those who sell sons or grandsons—one year of punishment.'
translations.idiomatic: [ Vice Minister of the Court of Justice Yang Jun opined: [4] "I have carefully examined the Theft Statute: 'Those who abduct persons or abduct and sell them into servitude—all death'; a separate article: 'Those who sell sons or grandsons—one year of punishment.'

sentences.zh: 賣良是一，而刑死懸殊者，由緣情制罰，則致罪有差。

translations.literal: Selling a freeborn person is one act, yet death and lesser punishments differ so greatly because punishments shaped by circumstance produce differences in offense.
translations.idiomatic: Selling a freeborn person is one act, yet the penalty ranges from death to lesser punishments because punishments tailored to circumstance produce differences in liability.

sentences.zh: 又詳『群盜強盜，首從皆同』，和掠之罪，固應不異。

translations.literal: Further I have examined: 'For bandit gangs and armed robbery, ringleaders and followers are alike'; the offense of joint abduction should naturally be no different.
translations.idiomatic: Further I note: 'For bandit gangs and armed robbery, ringleaders and followers are alike'; offenses of joint abduction should naturally be treated no differently.

sentences.zh: 及『知人掠盜之物，而故買者，以隨從論』。

translations.literal: And: 'Those who knowingly buy goods from abductors or robbers shall be judged as followers.'
translations.idiomatic: And: 'Those who knowingly buy goods taken by abduction or robbery shall be judged as accomplices.'

sentences.zh: 然五服相賣，皆有明條，買者之罪，律所不載。

translations.literal: Yet for selling among the five grades of mourning kin, there are clear articles; the buyer's offense the law does not record.
translations.idiomatic: Yet for selling among kin within the five grades of mourning, there are explicit articles; the buyer's offense is not recorded in the law.

sentences.zh: 竊謂同凡從法，其緣服相減者，宜有差，買者之罪，不得過於賣者之咎也。

translations.literal: This humble opinion holds that following the general law on followers, where kinship within mourning grades warrants reduction there should be differences; the buyer's offense must not exceed the seller's guilt.
translations.idiomatic: I hold that following the general law on accomplices, where kinship within mourning grades warrants reduction there should be differences; the buyer's offense must not exceed the seller's guilt.

sentences.zh: 但羊皮賣女為婢，不言追贖，張回真買，謂同家財，至於轉鬻之日，不復疑慮。

translations.literal: But Yangpi sold his daughter as a maidservant without mentioning redemption; Zhang Hui bought her outright, treating her as household property; on the day of resale he no longer hesitated.
translations.idiomatic: But Fei Yangpi sold his daughter as a maidservant without mentioning redemption; Zhang Hui bought her outright as household property, and on the day he resold her he no longer hesitated.

sentences.zh: 緣其買之於女父，便賣之於他人，准其和掠，此有因緣之類也。

translations.literal: Because he bought from the girl's father and then sold to another, measured against joint abduction—this belongs to the category of causal connection.
translations.idiomatic: Because he bought from the girl's father and then sold her to another, measured against joint abduction, this falls within the category of causal complicity.

sentences.zh: 又詳恐喝條注：『尊長與之已決，恐喝幼賤求之。

translations.literal: Further I have examined the commentary on the coercion article: 'When an elder has already decided the matter and coerces a junior of low status to seek it.
translations.idiomatic: Further I have examined the commentary on the coercion article: 'When an elder has already decided the matter and coerces a junior of inferior status to comply.

sentences.zh: 』然恐喝體同，而不受恐喝之罪者，以尊長與之已決故也。

translations.literal: ' Yet the substance of coercion is the same; those who do not receive punishment for coercion do so because the elder had already decided the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the substance of coercion is the same; those who escape punishment for coercion do so because the elder had already decided the matter.

sentences.zh: 而張回本買婢於羊皮，乃真賣於定之。

translations.literal: Yet Zhang Hui originally bought the maidservant from Yangpi and then sold her outright to Dingzhi.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Zhang Hui originally bought the maidservant from Fei Yangpi and then sold her outright to Dingzhi.

sentences.zh: 准此條例，得先有由；

translations.literal: Measured against this article, there was prior cause;
translations.idiomatic: Measured against this article, there was prior justification;

sentences.zh: 推之因緣，理頗相類。

translations.literal: Extended by causal connection, the principle is quite similar.
translations.idiomatic: Extended by causal connection, the principle is quite similar.

sentences.zh: 即狀准條，處流為允。

translations.literal: Judging the facts against the article, sentencing to exile is appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Judging the facts against the article, exile is the appropriate sentence.

translations.literal: Close of quoted passage.
translations.idiomatic: End of memorial quotation.

sentences.zh: 〔三公郎中崔鴻議曰：[6]「案律『賣子有一歲刑；

translations.literal: [ Director of the Three Dukes Office Cui Hong opined: [6] "According to the law: 'Selling a child—one year of punishment';
translations.idiomatic: [ Director of the Three Dukes Office Cui Hong opined: [6] "According to the law: 'Selling a child—one year of punishment';

sentences.zh: 賣五服內親屬，[7]在尊長者死，期親及妾與子婦流』。

translations.literal: Selling kin within the five grades of mourning, [7] if the seller is an elder—death; if within one year's mourning, or a concubine or daughter-in-law—exile.'
translations.idiomatic: 'Selling kin within the five grades of mourning—[7] if the seller is an elder, death; if a relative within one year's mourning, or a concubine or daughter-in-law, exile.'

sentences.zh: 唯買者無罪文。

translations.literal: Only for the buyer there is no guilt text.
translations.idiomatic: Only for the buyer is there no explicit penalty.

sentences.zh: 然〕賣者既以有罪，買者不得不坐。

translations.literal: Yet ] since the seller is guilty, the buyer cannot but be implicated.
translations.idiomatic: Yet since the seller is guilty, the buyer cannot but be implicated.

sentences.zh: 但賣者以天性難奪，支屬易遺，尊卑不同，故罪有異。

translations.literal: But the seller, because natural affection is hard to sever and collateral kin are easily cast off, and superior and inferior differ—therefore offenses differ.
translations.idiomatic: But sellers differ in guilt because natural affection is hard to sever, collateral kin are easily cast off, and superior and inferior positions differ.

sentences.zh: 買者知良故買，又於彼無親。

translations.literal: The buyer knowingly bought a freeborn person, and had no kinship with them there.
translations.idiomatic: The buyer knowingly purchased a freeborn person and had no kinship with the seller.

sentences.zh: 若買同賣者，即理不可。

translations.literal: If the buyer's offense equaled the seller's, the principle would not hold.
translations.idiomatic: If the buyer were punished equally with the seller, the principle would not hold.

sentences.zh: 何者？

translations.literal: Why?
translations.idiomatic: Why?

sentences.zh: 『賣五服內親屬，在尊長者死』，此亦非掠，從其真買，暨於致罪，刑死大殊。

translations.literal: 'Selling kin within the five grades of mourning—if an elder, death'—this too is not abduction; following a genuine purchase, by the time offense is incurred, punishment and death differ greatly.
translations.idiomatic: 'Selling kin within the five grades of mourning—if an elder, death'—this too is not abduction; following a genuine purchase, by the time the offense is complete, punishments range from death to lesser penalties.

sentences.zh: 明知買者之坐，自應一例，不得全如鈞議，云買者之罪，不過賣者之咎也。

translations.literal: Clearly knowing the buyer's imputation, it should naturally follow one rule—not wholly like Jun's opinion saying the buyer's offense must not exceed the seller's guilt.
translations.idiomatic: Clearly the buyer's liability should follow one rule—not wholly like Jun's opinion that the buyer's offense must not exceed the seller's guilt.

sentences.zh: 且買者於彼無天性支屬之義，何故得有差等之理？

translations.literal: Moreover, the buyer has no natural affection or collateral kinship with them there—why should there be grounds for graduated differences?
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, the buyer owes no natural affection or kinship to the party there—why should the penalty be graduated?

sentences.zh: 又案別條：『知人掠盜之物而故買者，以隨從論。

translations.literal: Further I consult a separate article: 'Those who knowingly buy goods taken by abduction or robbery shall be judged as followers.
translations.idiomatic: Further I cite a separate article: 'Those who knowingly buy goods taken by abduction or robbery shall be judged as accomplices.

sentences.zh: 』依此律文，知人掠良，從其宜買，罪止於流。

translations.literal: ' By this statutory text, knowingly abducting a freeborn person and following a proper purchase—the offense stops at exile.
translations.idiomatic: By this statutory text, when one knowingly deals with abducted freeborn persons or follows a proper purchase, the offense is capped at exile.

sentences.zh: 然其親屬相賣，坐殊凡掠。

translations.literal: Yet when kin sell one another, liability differs from ordinary abduction.
translations.idiomatic: Yet when kin sell one another, liability differs from ordinary abduction.

sentences.zh: 至於買者，亦宜不等。

translations.literal: As for the buyer, punishment likewise should not be equal.
translations.idiomatic: As for the buyer, the penalty likewise should not be equal.

sentences.zh: 若處同流坐，於法為深。

translations.literal: If sentenced to the same exile, by law this is too severe.
translations.idiomatic: If sentenced to the same exile, the penalty would be too severe by law.

sentences.zh: 準律斟降，合刑五歲。

translations.literal: Measured against the law and adjusted downward, the proper punishment is five years.
translations.idiomatic: Adjusted downward according to law, the proper sentence is five years' punishment.

sentences.zh: 至如買者，知是良人，決便真賣，不語前人得之由緒。

translations.literal: As for the buyer, knowing the person was freeborn, decisively selling outright without telling the prior party the circumstances of acquisition—
translations.idiomatic: As for the buyer who, knowing the person was freeborn, resells outright without telling the next purchaser how the person was acquired—

sentences.zh: 前人謂真奴婢，更或轉賣，因此流漂，[8]罔知所在，家人追贖，求訪無處，永沉賤隸，無復良期。

translations.literal: The prior party treats them as true slaves or maidservants and may resell again; thus adrift in exile, [8] nowhere to be found—family pursues redemption, seeks in vain, forever sunk in debased servitude with no return to free status.
translations.idiomatic: The next purchaser treats them as genuine slaves and may resell again; thus cast adrift, [8] with nowhere to be found—the family pursues redemption in vain, forever sunk in debased servitude with no hope of restoration to free status.

sentences.zh: 案其罪狀，與掠無異。

translations.literal: Examining the facts of the offense, it differs not from abduction.
translations.idiomatic: Examining the facts of the offense, it differs not from abduction.

sentences.zh: 且法嚴而姦易息，政寬而民多犯，水火之喻，先典明文。

translations.literal: Moreover, when law is strict wickedness easily ceases; when government is lenient the people commit many offenses—the metaphor of water and fire is plain in ancient texts.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, when law is strict, wickedness easily ceases; when government is lenient, the people commit many offenses—the analogy of water and fire is plain in the classics.

sentences.zh: 今謂買人親屬而復決賣，不告前人良狀由緒，處同掠罪。」

translations.literal: Now I hold that one who buys a person's kin and then resells outright, without telling the prior party the freeborn status and circumstances of acquisition, should be punished like abduction."
translations.idiomatic: I hold that one who buys a person's kin and then resells outright without disclosing to the prior purchaser the victim's freeborn status and the circumstances of acquisition should be punished as for abduction."

sentences.zh: 太保、高陽王雍議曰：「州處張回，專引盜律，檢回所犯，本非和掠，保證明然，去盜遠矣。

translations.literal: Grand Guardian Prince Yong of Gaoyang opined: "The province sentenced Zhang Hui by citing only the Theft Statute; examining Hui's offense, it was originally not joint abduction—the facts are clearly established and far removed from theft.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Guardian Prince Yong of Gaoyang opined: "The province sentenced Zhang Hui solely under the Theft Statute; examining his offense, it was not joint abduction—the facts are clear and the case is far removed from theft.

sentences.zh: 今引以盜律之條，處以和掠之罪，原情究律，實為乖當。

translations.literal: Now citing the Theft Statute's articles yet punishing with the offense of joint abduction—examining sentiment and investigating law, this is truly improper.
translations.idiomatic: To cite the Theft Statute yet punish for joint abduction—weighing the facts against the law, this is truly improper.

sentences.zh: 如臣鈞之議，知買掠良人者，本無罪文。

translations.literal: As in Minister Jun's opinion, for knowingly buying abducted freeborn persons there originally is no guilt text.
translations.idiomatic: As in Minister Jun's opinion, the law originally contains no explicit penalty for knowingly buying abducted freeborn persons.

sentences.zh: 何以言之？

translations.literal: Why say this?
translations.idiomatic: Why say this?

sentences.zh: 『羣盜強盜，無首從皆同』，和掠之罪，故應不異。

translations.literal: 'For bandit gangs and armed robbery, ringleaders and followers are alike'; the offense of joint abduction should therefore be no different.
translations.idiomatic: 'For bandit gangs and armed robbery, ringleaders and followers are alike'—offenses of joint abduction should therefore be treated no differently.

sentences.zh: 明此自無正條，引類以結罪。

translations.literal: This shows there is originally no direct article—categories are cited to fix guilt.
translations.idiomatic: This shows there is no direct article—the charge is fixed by analogy.

sentences.zh: 臣鴻以轉賣流漂，罪與掠等，可謂『罪人斯得』。

translations.literal: Minister Hong, holding that resale leading to drifting exile makes the offense equal to abduction, may be said to have 'got the guilty.'
translations.idiomatic: Minister Hong's view that resale leading to the victim's disappearance makes the offense equal to abduction may be said to have 'caught the guilty.'

sentences.zh: 案賊律云：『謀殺人而發覺者流，從者五歲刑；

translations.literal: The Assault Statute says: 'Those who plot murder and are discovered—exile; followers—five years of punishment';
translations.idiomatic: The Assault Statute says: 'Those who plot murder and are discovered—exile; accomplices—five years' punishment';

sentences.zh: 已傷及殺而還蘇者死，從者流；

translations.literal: Those who have already wounded or killed yet the victim revives—death; followers—exile;
translations.idiomatic: Those who have wounded or killed yet the victim revives—death; accomplices—exile;

sentences.zh: 已殺者斬，從而加功者死，不加者流。

translations.literal: Those already killed—decapitation; those who further contribute to the deed—death; those who do not contribute—exile.
translations.idiomatic: Those who have already killed are decapitated; those who further contribute to the deed are put to death; those who do not contribute are exiled.

sentences.zh: 』詳沉賤之與身死，流漂之與腐骨，一存一亡，為害孰甚？

translations.literal: ' Consider carefully: sinking into debased servitude versus bodily death, drifting exile versus rotting bones—one preserved, one lost—which harm is greater?
translations.idiomatic: Consider carefully: sinking into debased servitude versus bodily death, drifting exile versus rotting bones—one preserved, one lost—which harm is the greater?

sentences.zh: 然賊律殺人，有首從之科，盜人賣買，無唱和差等。

translations.literal: Yet the Assault Statute on killing has separate penalties for ringleaders and followers; buying and selling stolen persons has no gradations between instigators and accomplices.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the Assault Statute on killing distinguishes ringleaders from followers, while buying and selling abducted persons makes no distinction between instigators and accomplices.

sentences.zh: 謀殺之與和掠，同是良人，應為準例。

translations.literal: Plotted murder and joint abduction alike involve freeborn persons—they should serve as parallel precedents.
translations.idiomatic: Plotted murder and joint abduction both involve freeborn persons and should serve as parallel precedents.

sentences.zh: 所以不引殺人減之，降從強盜之一科。

translations.literal: That is why one should not cite murder to reduce the penalty, but instead apply the lesser category for followers of armed robbery.
translations.idiomatic: That is why one should not cite murder to reduce the penalty, but instead apply the lesser category reserved for followers of armed robbery.

sentences.zh: 縱令謀殺之與強盜，俱得為例，而似從輕。

translations.literal: Even if plotted murder and armed robbery could both serve as precedents, this would seem to treat the offense too leniently.
translations.idiomatic: Even if plotted murder and armed robbery could both serve as precedents, this would still seem to treat the offense too leniently.

sentences.zh: [9]其義安在？

translations.literal: Where, then, is the principle in this?
translations.idiomatic: Where, then, is the principle in this?

sentences.zh: 又云：『知人掠盜之物而故買者，以隨從論。

translations.literal: It also says: 'Those who knowingly buy goods taken by abduction or robbery shall be judged as accomplices.
translations.idiomatic: It also says: 'Those who knowingly buy goods taken by abduction or robbery shall be judged as accomplices.

sentences.zh: 』此明禁暴掠之原，遏姦盜之本，非謂市之於親尊之手，而同之於盜掠之刑。

translations.literal: ' This clearly bars the root of violent abduction and checks the foundation of wicked theft—it does not mean that buying from an elder or superior kin should carry the same penalty as robbery and abduction.
translations.idiomatic: This clearly bars the root of violent abduction and checks the foundation of wicked theft—it does not mean that buying from an elder or superior kin should carry the same penalty as robbery and abduction.

sentences.zh: 竊謂五服相賣，俱是良人，所以容有差等之罪者，明去掠盜理遠，故從親疏為差級，尊卑為輕重。

translations.literal: I hold that selling one another within the five grades of mourning—all are freeborn persons—the reason offenses may differ in degree is clearly that this is far removed from abduction and robbery; therefore penalties are graded by closeness of kin and weighted by superior and inferior rank.
translations.idiomatic: I hold that when kin within the five grades of mourning sell one another—all are freeborn—the reason the offense may differ in degree is that this is far removed from abduction and robbery; penalties should therefore be graded by closeness of kin and weighted by superior and inferior rank.

sentences.zh: 依律：『諸共犯罪，皆以發意為首。

translations.literal: According to the law: 'In all joint offenses, the one who originates the intent is the ringleader.
translations.idiomatic: According to the law: 'In all joint offenses, the one who originates the intent is the ringleader.

sentences.zh: 』明賣買之元有由，魁末之坐宜定。

translations.literal: ' This shows that in buy-and-sell cases there is an originator; the liability of ringleader and follower should be fixed accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: This shows that in buy-and-sell cases there is an originator; the liability of ringleader and follower should be fixed accordingly.

sentences.zh: 若羊皮不云賣，則回無買心，則羊皮為元首，張回為從坐。

translations.literal: If Yang Pi had not spoken of selling, Zhang Hui would have had no intent to buy; then Yang Pi would be the ringleader and Zhang Hui the follower.
translations.idiomatic: If Yang Pi had not spoken of selling, Zhang Hui would have had no intent to buy; Yang Pi would then be the ringleader and Zhang Hui the follower.

sentences.zh: 首有沾刑之科，從有極默之戾，推之憲律，法刑無據。

translations.literal: The ringleader bears a lighter shared penalty, the follower the utmost liability—pushed to constitutional law, there is no basis for such punishment.
translations.idiomatic: The ringleader bears a lighter shared penalty, the follower the utmost liability—applied to constitutional law, there is no basis for such a punishment.

sentences.zh: 買者之罪，宜各從賣者之坐。

translations.literal: The buyer's offense should in each case follow the seller's liability.
translations.idiomatic: The buyer's offense should in each case follow the seller's liability.

sentences.zh: 又詳臣鴻之議，有從他親屬買得良人，而復真賣，不語後人由狀者，處同掠罪。

translations.literal: Examining further Minister Hong's opinion: when one buys a freeborn person from another's kin and then resells outright without telling the next purchaser the circumstances, this should be punished as abduction.
translations.idiomatic: Examining further Minister Hong's opinion: when one buys a freeborn person from another's kin and then resells outright without telling the next purchaser the circumstances, the offense should be punished as abduction.

sentences.zh: 既一為婢，賣與不賣，俱非良人。

translations.literal: Once one has become a maidservant, whether sold or not, one is no longer freeborn.
translations.idiomatic: Once one has become a maidservant, whether sold or not, one is no longer freeborn.

sentences.zh: 何必以不賣為可原，轉賣為難恕。

translations.literal: Why must selling be forgivable while resale be harder to pardon?
translations.idiomatic: Why must selling be forgivable while resale be harder to pardon?

sentences.zh: 張回之愆，宜鞭一百。

translations.literal: Zhang Hui's fault warrants one hundred lashes.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Hui's fault warrants one hundred lashes.

sentences.zh: 賣子葬親，孝誠可美，而表賞之議未聞，刑罰之科已降。

translations.literal: Selling a child to bury a parent—the filial devotion is admirable—yet no proposal to commend him has been heard, while punishment has already been pronounced.
translations.idiomatic: Selling a child to bury a parent—the filial devotion is admirable—yet no proposal to commend him has been heard, while punishment has already been pronounced.

sentences.zh: 恐非敦風厲俗，以德導民之謂。

translations.literal: I fear this is not what is meant by encouraging customs and guiding the people through virtue.
translations.idiomatic: I fear this is not what is meant by encouraging customs and guiding the people through virtue.

sentences.zh: 請免羊皮之罪，公酬賣直。

translations.literal: I ask that Yang Pi's offense be pardoned and that the state reimburse the sale price.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that Yang Pi's offense be pardoned and that the state reimburse the sale price.

sentences.zh: 」詔曰：「羊皮賣女葬母，孝誠可嘉，便可特原。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Yang Pi sold his daughter to bury his mother—the filial devotion is commendable; let him be specially pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "Yang Pi sold his daughter to bury his mother—the filial devotion is commendable; let him be specially pardoned.

sentences.zh: 張回雖買之於父，不應轉賣，可刑五歲。」

translations.literal: Although Zhang Hui bought from the father, he should not have resold; sentence him to five years' punishment."
translations.idiomatic: Although Zhang Hui bought from the father, he should not have resold; sentence him to five years' punishment."

sentences.zh: 先是，皇族有譴，皆不持訊。

translations.literal: Previously, when members of the imperial clan were accused, none were subject to interrogation.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, when members of the imperial clan were accused, none were subject to interrogation.

sentences.zh: 時有宗士元顯富，犯罪須鞫，宗正約以舊制。

translations.literal: At the time clansman Yuan Xianfu had committed an offense requiring examination; the Director of the Imperial Clan invoked the old rule.
translations.idiomatic: At the time clansman Yuan Xianfu had committed an offense requiring examination; the Director of the Imperial Clan invoked the old rule.

sentences.zh: 尚書李平奏：「以帝宗磐固，周布於天下，其屬籍疏遠，蔭官卑末，無良犯憲，理須推究。

translations.literal: Minister Li Ping memorialized: "Since the imperial clan is firm as bedrock and spread throughout the realm, among those whose registration is distant and who hold low minor posts exempt from penalty, those who truly violate the law must be investigated.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Li Ping memorialized: "Since the imperial clan is firm as bedrock and spread throughout the realm, among those whose registration is distant and who hold low minor posts, those who truly violate the law must be investigated.

sentences.zh: 請立限斷，以為定式。

translations.literal: I ask that limits be established as a fixed standard.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that limits be established as a fixed standard.

sentences.zh: 」詔曰：「雲來綿遠，繁衍世滋，植籍宗氏，而為不善，量亦多矣。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Our lineage stretches from Yun long ago, multiplying through the generations; registered as members of the imperial house yet doing evil—there must be many.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "Our lineage stretches from Yun long ago, multiplying through the generations; registered as members of the imperial house yet doing evil—there must be many.

sentences.zh: 先朝既無不訊之格，而空相矯恃，以長違暴。

translations.literal: The previous reign had no rule of no interrogation, yet they emptyly relied on pretense, thus fostering violence against the law.
translations.idiomatic: The previous reign had no rule of exemption from interrogation, yet they emptyly relied on pretense, thus fostering violence against the law.

sentences.zh: 諸在議請之外，可悉依常法。」

translations.literal: All beyond what is under discussion here should fully follow ordinary law."
translations.idiomatic: All beyond what is under discussion here should fully follow ordinary law."

sentences.zh: 其年六月，兼廷尉卿元志、監王靖等上言：「檢除名之例，依律文，『獄成』謂處罪案成者。

translations.literal: That year, sixth month, Vice Minister of Justice Yuan Zhi, Supervisor Wang Jing, and others submitted: "Examining the precedent for removal from registry: according to the statute, 'case completed' means one whose sentence has been decided and the case finalized.
translations.idiomatic: That year, in the sixth month, Vice Minister of Justice Yuan Zhi, Supervisor Wang Jing, and others submitted: "Examining the precedent for removal from registry: according to the statute, 'case completed' means one whose sentence has been decided and the case finalized.

sentences.zh: 寺謂犯罪逕彈後，使覆檢鞫證定刑，罪狀彰露，案署分昞，獄理是成。

translations.literal: The Court holds that after a crime is directly impeached, when review and examination fix the punishment, the facts are clear, the case documents are distinct, and the judicial reasoning is complete—the case is finalized.
translations.idiomatic: The Court holds that after a crime is directly impeached, when review and examination fix the punishment, the facts are clear, the case documents are distinct, and the judicial reasoning is complete—the case is finalized.

sentences.zh: 若使案雖成，雖已申省，[10]事下廷尉，或寺以情狀未盡，或邀駕撾鼓，或門下立疑，更付別使者，可從未成之條。

translations.literal: If a case, though complete, though already reported to the Secretariat, when sent down to the Court of Judicatory—or when the Court finds the facts not fully known, or when someone beats the drum to intercept the imperial carriage, or when the Gate Office raises doubts and the case is transferred to another investigator—the rule for incomplete cases may apply.
translations.idiomatic: If a case, though complete and already reported to the Secretariat, is sent down to the Court of Judicatory—or when the Court finds the facts not fully known, or when someone beats the drum to intercept the imperial carriage, or when the Gate Office raises doubts and the case is transferred to another investigator—the rule for incomplete cases may apply.

sentences.zh: 其家人陳訴，信其專辭，而阻成斷，便是曲遂於私，有乖公體。

translations.literal: When family members lodge petitions and their one-sided words are believed, blocking a finalized judgment—this bends to private interests and violates public principle.
translations.idiomatic: When family members lodge petitions and their one-sided words are believed, blocking a finalized judgment—this bends to private interests and violates public principle.

sentences.zh: 何者？

translations.literal: Why?
translations.idiomatic: Why?

sentences.zh: 五詐既窮，六備已立，僥倖之輩，更起異端，進求延罪於漏刻，退希不測之恩宥，辯以惑正，曲以亂直，長民姦於下，隳國法於上，竊所未安。

translations.literal: The five stratagems are exhausted and the six proofs established, yet the opportunistic raise new objections—advancing to delay punishment until the last moment, retreating to hope for unforeseen amnesty—using argument to confuse the right, distortion to overturn the straight, fostering wickedness among the people below and destroying state law above—I have never been at ease with this.
translations.idiomatic: The five stratagems are exhausted and the six proofs established, yet the opportunistic raise new objections—advancing to delay punishment until the last moment, retreating to hope for unforeseen amnesty—using argument to confuse the right, distortion to overturn the straight, fostering wickedness among the people below and destroying state law above—I have never been at ease with this.

sentences.zh: 」大理正崔纂、評楊機、丞甲休、律博士劉安元以為：「律文，獄已成及決竟，經所綰，而疑有姦欺，不直於法，及訴冤枉者，得攝訊覆治之。

translations.literal: Director of Judgments Cui Zuan, Reviewer Yang Ji, Deputy Jia Xiu, and Legal Scholar Liu Anyuan held: "The statute provides that when a case is completed and the judgment final, passed through competent offices, yet fraud or false judgment is suspected, or wrongful conviction is petitioned—re-examination and retrial may be ordered.
translations.idiomatic: Director of Judgments Cui Zuan, Reviewer Yang Ji, Deputy Jia Xiu, and Legal Scholar Liu Anyuan held: "The statute provides that when a case is completed and the judgment final, passed through competent offices, yet fraud or false judgment is suspected, or wrongful conviction is petitioned—re-examination and retrial may be ordered.

sentences.zh: 檢使處罪者，雖已案成，御史風彈，以痛誣伏；

translations.literal: Those inspected and sentenced—even if the case is complete—when the censor impeaches and torture makes the false confession collapse;
translations.idiomatic: Those inspected and sentenced—even if the case is complete—when the censor impeaches and torture exposes the false confession;

sentences.zh: 或拷不承引，依證而科；

translations.literal: or when torture fails to produce confession but evidence supports conviction;
translations.idiomatic: or when torture fails to produce confession but evidence supports conviction;

sentences.zh: 或有私嫌，強逼成罪；

translations.literal: or when private enmity forces a false conviction;
translations.idiomatic: or when private enmity forces a false conviction;

sentences.zh: 家人訴枉，辭案相背。

translations.literal: when family petitions injustice and their words contradict the case files.
translations.idiomatic: when family petitions injustice and their words contradict the case files.

sentences.zh: 刑憲不輕，理須訊鞫。

translations.literal: Criminal law is no light matter—interrogation is required.
translations.idiomatic: Criminal law is no light matter—interrogation is required.

sentences.zh: 既為公正，豈疑於私。

translations.literal: Since this serves justice, how can it be suspected of private interest?
translations.idiomatic: Since this serves justice, how can it be suspected of private interest?

sentences.zh: 如謂規不測之澤，抑絕訟端，則枉滯之徒，終無申理。

translations.literal: If one holds that to block unforeseen favor one must cut off all petitions, then those wrongfully detained will never receive redress.
translations.idiomatic: If one holds that to block unforeseen favor one must cut off all petitions, then those wrongfully detained will never receive redress.

sentences.zh: 若從其案成，便乖覆治之律。

translations.literal: If one follows the completed case alone, this violates the law on retrial.
translations.idiomatic: If one follows the completed case alone, this violates the law on retrial.

sentences.zh: 然未判經赦，及覆治理狀，真偽未分，承前以來，如此例皆得復職。

translations.literal: Yet when judgment has not been passed and amnesty intervenes, or when retrial is pending and truth and falsehood are undivided, under precedent from earlier times such cases have all allowed restoration to office.
translations.idiomatic: Yet when judgment has not been passed and amnesty intervenes, or when retrial is pending and truth and falsehood are undivided, under precedent from earlier times such cases have all allowed restoration to office.

sentences.zh: 愚謂經奏遇赦，及已覆治，得為獄成。

translations.literal: I hold that after memorial to the throne encountering amnesty, and after retrial is completed, the case may be considered finalized.
translations.idiomatic: I hold that after memorial to the throne encountering amnesty, and after retrial is completed, the case may be considered finalized.

sentences.zh: 」尚書李韶奏：「使雖結案，處上廷尉，解送至省，及家人訴枉，尚書納辭，連解下鞫，未檢遇宥者，不得為案成之獄。

translations.literal: Minister Li Shao memorialized: "Even if the investigator has closed the case, when sent up to the Court of Judicatory, transferred to the Secretariat, or when family petitions injustice and the Ministry accepts the petition and the case is sent down for examination—if amnesty has not yet been applied after review, it cannot count as a completed case.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Li Shao memorialized: "Even if the investigator has closed the case, when sent up to the Court of Judicatory, transferred to the Secretariat, or when family petitions injustice and the Ministry accepts the petition and the case is sent down for examination—if amnesty has not yet been applied after review, it cannot count as a completed case.

sentences.zh: 推之情理，謂崔纂等議為允。

translations.literal: Weighing sentiment and reason, I hold the opinion of Cui Zuan and others to be sound.
translations.idiomatic: Weighing sentiment and reason, I hold the opinion of Cui Zuan and others to be sound.

sentences.zh: 」詔從之。

translations.literal: The edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: The edict approved.

sentences.zh: 熙平中，有冀州妖賊延陵王買，負罪逃亡，赦書斷限之後，不自歸首。

translations.literal: In the Xiping era, there was a sorcerer-rebel in Jizhou, Yanling Wang Mai, who fled after committing an offense and did not surrender himself after the amnesty deadline.
translations.idiomatic: In the Xiping era, there was a sorcerer-rebel in Jizhou, Yanling Wang Mai, who fled after committing an offense and did not surrender himself after the amnesty deadline.

sentences.zh: 廷尉卿裴延儁上言：「法例律：『諸逃亡，赦書斷限之後，不自歸首者，復罪如初。

translations.literal: Minister of Justice Pei Yanjun submitted: "The Precedents Statute: 'All fugitives who after the amnesty deadline do not surrender themselves—punishment restored as originally.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Justice Pei Yanjun submitted: "The Precedents Statute: 'All fugitives who after the amnesty deadline do not surrender themselves—punishment restored as originally.

sentences.zh: 』依賊律，謀反大逆，處買梟首。

translations.literal: ' Under the Assault Statute, plotting rebellion and great treason—sentence Mai to display of the severed head.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Assault Statute, plotting rebellion and great treason—sentence Mai to display of the severed head.

sentences.zh: [11]其延陵法㩲等所謂月光童子劉景暉者，[12]妖言惑眾，事在赦後，亦合死坐。

translations.literal: As for Yanling Wang Mai and others' so-called Moonlight Boy Liu Jinghui—the offense of heterodox speech deceiving the masses, though occurring after the amnesty, still warrants death.
translations.idiomatic: As for Yanling Wang Mai and others' so-called Moonlight Boy Liu Jinghui—the offense of heterodox speech deceiving the masses, though occurring after the amnesty, still warrants death.

sentences.zh: 」正崔纂以為：「景暉云能變為蛇雉，此乃傍人之言。

translations.literal: Director Cui Zuan held: "Jinghui's claim that he could transform into serpent or pheasant—this is hearsay from others.
translations.idiomatic: Director Cui Zuan held: "Jinghui's claim that he could transform into serpent or pheasant—this is hearsay from others.

sentences.zh: 雖殺暉為無理，恐赦暉復惑眾。

translations.literal: Though killing Jinghui would be unjust, I fear that pardoning Jinghui would again deceive the masses.
translations.idiomatic: Though killing Jinghui would be unjust, I fear that pardoning Jinghui would again deceive the masses.

sentences.zh: 是以依違，不敢專執。

translations.literal: Hence I waver and dare not decide alone.
translations.idiomatic: Hence I waver and dare not decide alone.

sentences.zh: 當今不諱之朝，不應行無罪之戮。

translations.literal: In this court that does not taboo speech, execution of the innocent should not be carried out.
translations.idiomatic: In this court that does not taboo speech, execution of the innocent should not be carried out.

sentences.zh: 景暉九歲小兒，口尚乳臭，舉動云為，並不關己，『月光』之稱，不出其口。

translations.literal: Jinghui is a nine-year-old child, his mouth still milky; his words and deeds concern him not at all—the title 'Moonlight' never came from his lips.
translations.idiomatic: Jinghui is a nine-year-old child, his mouth still milky; his words and deeds concern him not at all—the title 'Moonlight' never came from his lips.

sentences.zh: 皆姦吏無端，橫生粉墨，所謂為之者巧，殺之者能。

translations.literal: All this was groundlessly fabricated by corrupt officials who falsely inscribed guilt—the saying goes: 'Those who fabricate are cunning; those who kill are capable.'
translations.idiomatic: All this was groundlessly fabricated by corrupt officials who falsely inscribed guilt—as the saying goes: 'Those who fabricate are cunning; those who kill are capable.'

sentences.zh: 若以妖言惑眾，據律應死，然更不破□惑眾。

translations.literal: Even if judged by heterodox speech deceiving the masses, death would be warranted by law—yet the case still does not establish deceiving the masses.
translations.idiomatic: Even if judged by heterodox speech deceiving the masses, death would be warranted by law—yet the case still does not establish deceiving the masses.

sentences.zh: 赦令之後方顯其事；

translations.literal: The matter came to light only after the amnesty decree;
translations.idiomatic: The matter came to light only after the amnesty decree;

sentences.zh: [13]律令之外，更求其罪。

translations.literal: Beyond statute and ordinance, one seeks further guilt.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond statute and ordinance, one seeks further guilt.

sentences.zh: 赦律何以取信於天下，天下焉得不疑於赦律乎！

translations.literal: How can amnesty law win the world's trust—how can the world not doubt amnesty law!
translations.idiomatic: How can amnesty law win the world's trust—how can the world not doubt amnesty law!

sentences.zh: 書曰：與殺無辜，寧失有罪。

translations.literal: The Documents say: Better to spare the innocent than to miss the guilty.
translations.idiomatic: The Documents say: Better to spare the innocent than to miss the guilty.

sentences.zh: 又案法例律：『八十已上，八歲已下，殺傷論坐者上請。

translations.literal: Further examining the Precedents Statute: 'Those eighty or above, eight or below, liable for killing or wounding—memorialize for imperial decision.
translations.idiomatic: Further examining the Precedents Statute: 'Those eighty or above, eight or below, liable for killing or wounding—memorialize for imperial decision.

sentences.zh: 』議者謂悼耄之罪，不用此律。

translations.literal: ' Some argue that offenses of the aged and the very young do not use this statute.

translations.idiomatic: The text below adds that under the Yongping statutes, guilt must be assigned to the principal offense before accomplices—a separate ground for the 'moreover according' reading.
